newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices down again at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices down again at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Coffee prices fell by as much as $7 at Kenya's weekly export auction on Tuesday in the third successive week of losses, traders said.

A senior official from the Kenya Coffee Auctions Ltd said the market was much weaker. Premium grade AAs averaged $133 per 50 kg bag from $138.50, grade ABs fell to $124 from $132 while grade Cs eased to $122 from 129.
"For a third week the market declined. There was very little price variation between the main grades," an official said.
The Coffee Board said it sold all 40,500 60-kg bags it offered for sale, compared with 40,698 sold last week.
